pick.name: Upwork
pick.why: Largest buyer pool for AI/automation work; variable 0-15% fee (secondary source)
pick.free_limits: Free account; Connects needed to bid (price unverified)

best_free.name: Contra
best_free.why: Commission-free freelance marketplace and portfolio; free plan usable for commercial work with per-payment fees
best_free.free_limits: 0% commission; free plan charges a client-payment fee (USD 15-29 per payment) and 5% on digital products (min USD 3, max USD 29), plus third-party processing; Pro USD 29/mo or USD 199/yr removes these fees

alts.name: Fiverr
alts.what: largest gig marketplace for productised fixed-scope services; seller fee reported at 20% (official page 403, verify)

candidates.name: Upwork
candidates.verdict: PICK for early demand and reviews

decision: Use Upwork for first projects and reviews with a narrow niche profile, run direct outbound in parallel, and move repeat clients off-platform where terms allow.
details: Upwork official fee page blocked fetch; fee figures secondary.
